'''2009 US West Nationals''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 12–13 September 2009, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS17]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2009 US West Nationals Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2009 US West Nationals Day 2.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 12–13 September 2009
* '''Winner:''' —
